params.name: category
params.description: Filter by canonical category. Repeat the param to filter to multiple categories (Sports, Crypto, Politics, Finance, Entertainment, Science & Tech, Weather, World Affairs, Health, Social, Other).

params.name: expiration_date_start
params.description: Start of expiration date range (inclusive, ISO 8601)

params.name: expiration_date_end
params.description: End of expiration date range (exclusive, ISO 8601)

params.name: start_datetime_after
params.description: Filter to markets with start_datetime >= this (ISO 8601)

params.name: start_datetime_before
params.description: Filter to markets with start_datetime < this (ISO 8601)

params.name: last_price_min
params.description: Filter to markets with last_price >= this value (0.0–1.0 YES probability).

params.name: last_price_max
params.description: Filter to markets with last_price <= this value (0.0–1.0 YES probability).

params.name: volume_min
params.description: Filter to events whose total summed volume >= this value.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort mode for event-based pagination: trending, volume, newest, ending-soon, start-time, price

params.name: event_limit
params.description: Paginate by events instead of markets. Up to 200 by default; values above that require start_datetime_after or start_datetime_before.

items.docs:
Search and browse markets across all exchanges.

Supports:
- Exact match on ticker, condition_id, slug, river_id
- Full-text search on name, description, tags
- Browse by filters (no query required)
- Results ranked by relevance

We default to active markets in the view so things are faster
Exact match a single market by Kalshi ticker or Polymarket slug. Supply exactly one.

Batch-resolve many markets by exact Kalshi ticker and/or Polymarket slug in one request.

The single-market ``/match`` endpoint costs one round-trip per identifier, so resolving
thousands of mappings serially is slow. This endpoint takes lists of tickers and/or slugs
(send them together in one call) and returns a full market row — including ``river_id``,
``ticker``, ``slug`` and ``exchange_name`` — for every identifier that matched. Identifiers
with no match come back in ``unmatched_tickers`` /
